notes.title: 🎉 A Release Full of UI Touches and Effects! 🎉
notes.notes:
Our game is now officially live — you can play it right now!

🛠️ UI Fixes and Improvements
We’ve gone through all the missing or buggy UI elements one by one. Everything is now cleaner and smoother! ✅
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/2821aa4e9546d8b7415121e50feddcc85afa6290.png
✨ Smooth Panel Open-Close Effects
Panels no longer pop in and out suddenly! We’ve added sweet animations for a better experience. 🧃
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/784ed36877f334253e48359dd97a4bf8bd80a616.png
🎞️ UI Animations
We’ve added small but effective animations to various interface elements. 💫
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/870e68b3537efb0ad31d39cf529953f7a783f743.png
🌟 Effects for Supporter and Streamer Tag UIs
Special effects have been added to the Supporter and Streamer Tags. 💖
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/b404cfebe524fbddfb9372ba582f5c76d346b060.png
🎁 Updated Supporter Tag Claim Screen
We fixed a bug that occurred while claiming the Supporter Tag and added a new animation to the process. 🏷️⚡
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/1ff0cd59b8a2edf386985856082b040c3bcce958.png
With all these changes, the UI is now more polished, both visually and in terms of user experience. We’re excited to hear your feedback! 🙌
